issues.reason: Gap territory: with an indefinite-singular subject over a verbal predicate the Existential section forces a witness rather than a rule ("a verbal generic takes a bare plural or an explicit quantifier ... not 'a dog'"), so the frequency dial has no rule or flat generic to ride on, while a positive event bundled as one (And ...) fact is a precedented well-typed container (the Disjunction section's "one (And ...) fact ... like a negated event" at STV 1.0 0.99), every conjunct is true of the sentence, and Core patterns bars dropping the hedge instead of carrying it.

The companion "only ever restates a range the rule itself quantifies - never a range that appears nowhere else in the parse", and this parse quantifies over no kind (the subject is the witness sk_sky_cat_1), so (QuantifierPhrase sky_cat carry "sometimes") would invent a kind-level range the parse never states - a coverage gap, not a parse defect.

gaps_confirmed: a frequency adverb on a verbal clause with an indefinite-singular subject: the Existential section forces a witness, while the frequency strength and its QuantifierPhrase companion are defined only over a rule or a flat generic, leaving the adverb no licensed carrier
new_gaps: an indefinite witness posited only by a sub-1.0-strength bundle has no stated projection rule - the "what projects out of a seal" table covers strength-0 denials and attitude seals only, so nothing says whether (Member sk_nightmoth_1 nightmoth) belongs inside the graded bundle or at top level at full strength
notes: Compound handling (sky_cat genus cat, solid-spelled nightmoth genus moth, noun modifiers unexposed), the definite-plural group witness, the non-recipient Goal and the (In ... flight) preposition-named oblique are all correct. The one residual worry is the full-strength nightmoth witness sitting outside the 0.5 bundle that is its only source - filed above as a gap rather than as an issue.
